author: Fable (autonomous)
motivation: fixed@512 (512-motion pool) loses 9.5 clean vs the release on unseen motions but only 5.9 on seen ones: part of the clean cost is content-specific. Fine-tuning on the 2,972-motion adaptation split (content-linked; dev and test untouched) tests whether breadth removes it.

design.training_pool: adapt4950 content split, partition adaptation (2,972 motions), materialized at pools/adapt4950/content_adaptation

panels.seen102: debug512 content-dev (note: 305 of the 512 debug motions are inside the adaptation split; this panel is 'partly seen' for this arm)
panels.unseen200: adapt4950 content-dev minus debug512 (disjoint from the adaptation split by construction)

hypotheses.H_P1: unseen200 id_clean >= 92 (clean cost vs release <= 5.5, halving the 9.5)
hypotheses.H_P2: unseen200 dr_full >= 77 (robustness gain retained within 3 pts of 79.8)
